notes: Identity independently checked: canonical text is the full PMC author-manuscript report, not a secondary article or preregistration. Header names Rany Abend, Mira A Bajaj and the supplied coauthors, prints DOI 10.1007/s10802-020-00712-w and final journal 49(2):227–240, dated 2020 Oct 23 (issue February 2021). Its title uses plural “Biases”, a minor title wording difference from the neutral reference. Methods, Results, Discussion and references are present. No PDF supplied; canonical web text has no manuscript page boundaries, so p. 6/p. 7 cannot be verified as page locators. Only n_o is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Study 1 dimensional correlation of dwell-time bias with overall SCARED anxiety severity is identifiable by the Study 1 identifier, anxiety relationship and requested r metric. The source prints r(48) = .29 but does not explicitly state this correlation’s analytic N or final mutually exclusive groups. The 53-person task-completion sample precedes three dwell-time outlier removals. The analysis section does not explicitly give correlation-specific missingness/retention. Hence no analytic N is extracted; no N is inferred from df. Candidate only: 29 + 24 = 53 task completers; (29 - 1) + (24 - 2) = 50 after dwell-time outlier exclusions (28 patients, 22 healthy). Final group counts are calculated rather than explicitly printed, and correlation-specific completeness is not stated. The printed correlation df is not used to derive N. Other printed statistics are candidate/target-identification context only; unassigned es and p remain null.
